# olivares_agent (Resource)

An agent registered in the Olivares AI control plane.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "olivares_agent" "billing" {
  name        = "billing-agent"
  kind        = "worker"
  external_id = "svc-billing-42"
  status      = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Agent kind/type discriminator.
- `name` (String) Human-readable agent name.

### Optional

- `external_id` (String) Caller-defined external identifier for correlation.
- `status` (String) Agent status. Defaults to "active".
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID for this resource, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned agent ID.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant the agent belongs to, as resolved by the engine.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 last-update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Optimistic-concurrency version assigned by the engine.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import olivares_agent.billing agt_01HX...
```
